versus.Bark: Publishes far more, with 22 new and 56 updated pages, mostly comparisons and guides. Life360 shows 0 new pages and 1 update.
versus.Qustodio: Much smaller than Bark, but still has 3 new topical guides in 30 days. Life360 published none.
versus.GeoZilla: Nothing published or updated in 30 days, like Life360. Neither shows fresh content, so no gap either way.

versus.Google Family Link: No new or updated pages and no page data, like Life360. Little content competition from them here.
